title: findexe: search the PATH
summary: getenv + string handling + access(X_OK), like a tiny `which -a`.
hints: getenv("PATH") returns a pointer into the environment: copy it before you change it (strtok writes into the string).
Split on ':' and build "dir/name" with snprintf into a char buffer.
access(path, X_OK) == 0 means the file exists and you may execute it.
info: getenv(name) returns NULL if unset. strtok_r(s, ":", &save) splits a modifiable string. access(path, X_OK) checks execute permission for the real user.
